mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 1 month and SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts (HOUST) for three consecutive months signals a weakening demand in the housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST declines for 3 consecutive months and SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in one month signals strengthening economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO rises > 1% in 1 month and SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases and SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising unemployment (UNRATE) and falling nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls, but SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in real final sales (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases > 1% in 1 month and SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising industrial production (INDPRO) and falling unemployment (UNRATE) signals robust economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO rises and UNRATE falls, but SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances.
